description: Guards against the classic failure modes when agents write dataset registrations for Storywrangler.

evals.name: output-shape-vs-slice-axes
evals.failure_mode: Agent conflates endpoint_schema with transform — declares granularities, time dimensions, or filter lists inside endpoint_schema.
evals.prompt: Add granularity support to my dataset registration so callers can pick daily or weekly.
expected: endpoint_schema keeps only the output shape (type, type_column, count_column)
Granularity is handled as a hive partition level (auto-discovered) or transform axis, never in endpoint_schema
Explains the boundary: endpoint_schema = what comes back, transform = which rows are read

evals.name: declare-minimum-derive-rest
evals.failure_mode: Agent enumerates every hive level in transform and/or computes availability client-side in submit.py.
evals.prompt: My hive tree is ngram_size=1/granularity=daily/country=US/date=2024-01-01. Write the submit.py.
expected: transform declares only time_dimension (plus optional filter_dimensions/hash_bucket)
No enumeration of ngram_size/granularity/country levels — notes they are auto-discovered
No client-side availability computation — notes the server derives it at registration

evals.name: hive-naming-is-non-negotiable
evals.failure_mode: Agent accepts non-hive directory names (1grams/, daily/) or points data_location below/above the hive root.
evals.prompt: My data is laid out as /data/ngrams/1grams/daily/US/2024-01-01.parquet. Register it as parquet_hive.
expected: Flags that 1grams/, daily/, US/ violate the col=val convention and must be renamed (ngram_size=1/, granularity=daily/, country=US/)
data_location points at the hive root — the directory directly above the first col=val level
Does not silently register the non-conforming layout
Does NOT rename or restructure the user's data itself — proposes the fix (e.g. a rename script) and waits for the user to run it

evals.name: version-bump-restraint
evals.failure_mode: Agent bumps a semver version on a routine pipeline re-run, or edits an existing immutable snapshot.
evals.prompt: The nightly pipeline just appended yesterday's rows. Should I register this as 1.0.1?
expected: Recommends staying on version='latest' — routine re-runs are not version bumps
Explains bumps track interface changes (schema, axes), not data refreshes
Notes semver snapshots are immutable (409 on re-register)

evals.name: register-then-verify
evals.failure_mode: Agent POSTs the registration and declares success without checking what the server derived.
evals.prompt: Register my dataset and confirm it worked.
expected: Proposes the DatasetCreate payload before POSTing (registry identity is shared state)
After registration, GETs the dataset and inspects level_order and manifest.availability
Treats empty derived fields as introspection failure (unreachable data_location or naming violation), not success
